name: beatclip
description: BeatClip - Offline Musik Player mit Schnittfunktion (PWA + native Android-/iOS-Pakete via Capacitor)

scripts.apk:debug: npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd .. && node tools/publish_android_apk.js debug
scripts.apk:release: npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease && cd .. && node tools/publish_android_apk.js release
scripts.ios:open: npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
